source: 你增强施法距离内你可见的至多六名生物的防御。此法术赋予受术者共计120点临时生命值 ，由你在受术者中任意分配。
target: You bolster the defenses of up to six creatures you can see within range. The spell grants a total of 120 Temporary Hit Points, which you distribute among the targets as you choose.
note: The 120 Temporary HP is a shared total, not an amount per target.

source:
你创造一个自己的幻象分身，并使其在法术持续时间内维持存在。该分身可以出现在施法距离内你曾见过的任何地点，而不论中间是否存在障碍物。该幻象看起来和听起来都与你一样，只是没有现实形体。幻象受到伤害时会立即消失，法术终止。
你可以通过分身的眼睛视物，用分身的耳朵聆听，如同你处于它的位置一样。用一个魔法动作，你能使分身移动至多60尺，而其姿态、言语和行为均按照你的指定作表现。幻象可以完美地模仿你的举止。
由于东西可以穿过幻象，任何与该幻象进行的物理互动都会暴露其幻觉本质。一名生物可以采取研究动作进行一次对抗你法术豁免DC的成功智力（调查）检定以看穿幻象。辨出幻象的生物可以看穿该影像，其产生的声响对该生物而言显得虚假。
target:
You create an illusory duplicate of yourself that lasts for the duration. It can appear at any place within range that you have seen, regardless of intervening obstacles. It looks and sounds like you but has no physical substance. If the illusion takes damage, it immediately disappears and the spell ends.
You can see through the duplicate's eyes and hear through its ears as though you were in its space. As a Magic action, you can move it up to 60 feet and direct its gestures, speech, and behavior. The illusion can perfectly mimic your mannerisms.
Physical interaction with the illusion reveals its illusory nature, since things can pass through it. A creature can take a Study action and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern the illusion. A creature that recognizes it can see through the image, and its sounds seem false to that creature.
note: All appearance, placement, perception, movement, damage-ending, and Study-action clauses are retained; no loss of the caster's own senses is added.

source: 一名你触及的生物恢复4d8+15点生命值。在持续时间内，目标在其每回合开始时恢复1点生命值，且其失去的任何身体部位都将在2分钟后重新长出。
target: A creature you touch regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points. For the duration, it regains 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns, and any missing body parts regrow after 2 minutes.
note: Preserves the healing formula, start-turn recovery, and two-minute regrowth without adding a reattachment shortcut.

source:
你触碰一名已死，但死亡时间不超过100年，并非死于年老，且死亡时并非亡灵的生物，使其回生。
生物以生命值全满的状态重生。该法术同样会中和在该生物死亡时仍在生效的毒素。该法术能治愈所有致命伤，恢复所有失去的身体部位。
死而复生是一个痛苦的体验。目标进行D20检定时具有-4减值。目标每完成一次长休，其减值就减少1，直至减值变为0。
使用该法术复活一名已死去365日或更久的生物会使你耗费大量精力。在你完成一次长休前，你将无法再施展任何法术，且此时你进行的一切D20检定具有劣势。
target:
You touch a dead creature and restore it to life, provided it has been dead no more than 100 years, didn't die of old age, and wasn't Undead when it died.
The creature returns with all its Hit Points. The spell also neutralizes poisons that were affecting it when it died, heals all mortal wounds, and restores all missing body parts.
Returning from death is painful. The target takes a -4 penalty to D20 Tests. Each Long Rest it finishes reduces the penalty by 1 until it reaches 0.
Restoring a creature that has been dead for 365 days or longer greatly taxes you. Until you finish a Long Rest, you can't cast any spells and have Disadvantage on all D20 Tests.
note: The 100-year eligibility, 365-day caster cost, poison removal, and separate target/caster penalties are preserved. No unprinted disease clause is imported.

source:
该法术以施法距离内一点为中心，创造一个半径50尺、高100尺的重力反转柱状区域。区域内所有未被固定在地面上的生物和物件都会向上落去，直到碰到该区域顶端为止。一名生物可以进行一次敏捷豁免以抓住一件他能触及的固定物件，从而避免向上坠落。
如果目标在坠落过程中撞上任何固体（比如天花板或被固定的物件），则坠落的物件和生物会受到同样情况下正常坠落时所会受到的冲击。如果一个物件或生物到达该区域的顶部并且没有撞到任何东西，则它将在持续时间内悬浮在该处。法术终止时，所有受术物件和受术生物向下坠落。
target:
This spell reverses gravity in a Cylinder with a radius of 50 feet and a height of 100 feet centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects in the area that aren't anchored to the ground fall upward until they reach the top of the area. A creature can make a Dexterity saving throw to grab a fixed object within its reach and avoid falling upward.
If a falling creature or object strikes a solid surface, such as a ceiling or an anchored object, it suffers the impact it would suffer from a normal fall under the same circumstances. If it reaches the top of the area without striking anything, it floats there for the duration. When the spell ends, all affected objects and creatures fall downward.
note: Preserves the grab-save option, impact comparison, floating endpoint, and final downward fall without adding damage values.

source:
你触碰一个物件或自愿生物，以魔法将其隔离起来。在法术持续期间，目标具有隐形状态并且不会被预言系法术作为目标，不会被魔法侦测，也不会被魔法远程观察到。
如果目标是一个生物，它会进入静滞。它陷入失能状态，不会衰老，也不需要进食、饮水或呼吸空气。
你可以设置一个让该法术提前终止的条件。该条件由你自由设定，但必须是发生在目标周围 1 里范围内或能在目标周围1里范围内看到的事件。例如：“1000 年以后”或者“当泰拉斯奎巨兽苏醒时”。如果受术者受到任何伤害，则该法术立刻终止。
target:
You touch an object or a willing creature and magically sequester it. For the duration, the target has the Invisible condition, can't be targeted by Divination spells, and can't be detected or remotely observed by magic.
If the target is a creature, it enters suspended animation. It has the Incapacitated condition, doesn't age, and doesn't need to eat, drink, or breathe air.
You can set a condition that ends the spell early. You choose the condition, but it must be an event that occurs within 1 li of the target or can be seen within 1 li of it. Examples include "after 1000 years" or "when the tarrasque awakens." The spell ends immediately if the target takes any damage.
note: Both source 1-li occurrence/visibility bounds and bare units are retained, with both example conditions and damage termination complete.

source:
你创造一个野兽或类人生物的拟像，该生物在整段施法时间内必须一直在你的10尺内。结束施法时，你同时触碰该生物以及和该生物同样体型的一堆冰或者雪，然后冰雪变化为该生物的拟像。拟像是一个生物。它使用拟像对象本体在施法时的游戏数据，但其类别为构装，生命值上限为本体生命值上限的一半，并且它无法施展拟像术。
拟像对你和你所选定的生物态度友善。它服从你的命令并在战斗中你的回合里行动。拟像不能升级，也不能进行短休和长休。
如果拟像受到了伤害，想让其生命值恢复的唯一手段就是为其进行修理（作为长休 的一部分）。而若想要修理一个拟像，拟像必须在长休期间时刻处于你周围5尺内，且每为其恢复一点生命值就需要消耗你价值100GP的法术耗材。
拟像会一直持续到其生命值降至0为止，在生命值降至0时它会变回冰雪并立刻融化。再次施放此法术时，任何你已用此法术创造出来的拟像都会立刻被摧毁。
target:
You create a simulacrum of a Beast or Humanoid that must remain within 10 feet of you throughout the casting. At the end of the casting, you touch both the creature and a pile of ice or snow of the same size as it, transforming the ice or snow into its simulacrum. The simulacrum is a creature. It uses the original creature's game statistics at the time of casting, except that its type is Construct, its Hit Point maximum is half the original's, and it can't cast Simulacrum.
The simulacrum is friendly to you and creatures you designate. It obeys your commands and acts on your turn in combat. It can't gain levels or take Short Rests or Long Rests.
If damaged, it can regain Hit Points only through repairs performed as part of a Long Rest. To repair it, you must keep it within 5 feet of you throughout the rest and expend 100 GP worth of spell components for each Hit Point restored.
The simulacrum remains until its Hit Points drop to 0, when it reverts to ice or snow and immediately melts. Casting this spell again immediately destroys any simulacra you previously created with it.
note: All casting proximity, copied-stat exceptions, no-rest/no-level restrictions, repair cost/proximity, and recasting destruction remain. The source doesn't repeat who takes the repair Long Rest; it is described as the repair process rather than granting the simulacrum rest benefits.

source:
施展该法术时，你在某个表面（诸如地板或墙的一部分）或某个能被关闭的物件里（诸如书本或宝箱）刻下一个伤害性的符纹。符纹可以覆盖周边不超过 10 尺直径的区域。如果你指定某个物件，则该物件必须待在其所在位置；如果该物件从你施法的位置被移动超过 10 尺，则其符纹被破坏且法术不被触发即告终止。
该符纹近乎隐形，其需要成功以法术的豁免 DC 进行一次智力（调查）检定才能被发现。
你在刻下符文时决定该符纹的触发条件并选择徽记承载的效应：死亡、争斗、恐惧、痛苦、睡眠或震慑。对应效应在下面详述。

设置触发条件Set the Trigger。 你在施法时决定由什么来触发符纹。刻画于表面的符纹其通常的触发条件包括：触碰或站立在符纹上；拿掉覆盖在符纹上的物件；进入符纹一定施法距离。刻画在物件内的符纹其通常的触发条件包括：打开物件；看到该符纹等。
你可以进一步细化触发条件以便特定生物种类才能激活之（例如将符纹设定为影响异怪）。你还可以将符合条件者排除在符纹触发者之外，例如说出特定口令的人。
符纹一旦被触发就会开始变大，使其周围 60 尺半径的球状区域处于微光光照并持续 10 分钟，此后法术即告终止。符纹生效时，所有位于球状区域内的生物即成为法术效应的目标。生物在一个回合内第一次进入该区域内或在其中结束其回合时，也同样会成为符文效应的目标。一个生物每回合只能成为其目标一次。
　　• 死亡Death。每个目标进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败者将受到 10d10 点暗蚀伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
　　• 争斗Discord。每个目标进行一次感知豁免。豁免失败者将在接下来的 1 分钟内将不停地与其他生物争吵。期间它无法进行任何有意义的沟通，并且其进行的所有攻击检定和属性检定都具有劣势。
　　• 恐惧Fear。每个目标进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败者将陷入 1 分钟的恐慌状态。被恐慌时，该生物只要可能，就必须在其回合内向远离符文的方向移动至少 30 尺。
　　• 痛苦Pain。每个目标进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败者将陷入 1 分钟的失能状态。
　　• 睡眠Sleep。每个目标进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败者将陷入 10 分钟的昏迷状态。该睡眠者受到伤害时将会被惊醒，也可以被其他人用一个动作摇醒。
　　• 震慑Stunning。每个目标进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败者将陷入 1 分钟的震慑状态。
target:
When you cast this spell, you inscribe a harmful glyph on a surface, such as a section of floor or wall, or inside an object that can be closed, such as a book or chest. The glyph can cover an area no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If you choose an object, it must remain in place; moving it more than 10 feet from where you cast the spell breaks the glyph and ends the spell without triggering it.
The glyph is nearly invisible and requires a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to find.
When you inscribe the glyph, you decide its trigger and choose the effect it carries: Death, Discord, Fear, Pain, Sleep, or Stunning. These effects are detailed below.

Set the Trigger. You decide what triggers the glyph when you cast the spell. Typical triggers for a glyph on a surface include touching or standing on it, removing an object covering it, or coming within a certain range of it. For a glyph inside an object, typical triggers include opening the object or seeing the glyph.
You can refine the trigger so that only particular creature types activate it, such as Aberrations. You can also exempt creatures that meet certain criteria, such as those that say a specific password.
Once triggered, the glyph expands, shedding Dim Light in a Sphere with a radius of 60 feet for 10 minutes, after which the spell ends. When it activates, all creatures in the Sphere become targets of its effect. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there also becomes a target. A creature can be targeted only once per turn.
• Death. Each target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d10 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
• Discord. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it argues with other creatures for the next 1 minute. During that time, it can't communicate meaningfully and has Disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks.
• Fear. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened, it must move at least 30 feet away from the glyph on its turn if possible.
• Pain. Each target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Incapacitated condition for 1 minute.
• Sleep. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Unconscious condition for 10 minutes. The sleeper wakes if it takes damage or if someone uses an action to shake it awake.
• Stunning. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Stunned condition for 1 minute.
note: All six supplied effects are complete; no other Symbol option is imported. Trigger/exemption details, moved-object failure, full initial/entry/end-turn targeting, once-per-turn limit, and each save/duration remain.

source:
此法术立即将你和至多八名施法距离内你可见的自愿生物，或者施法距离内你可见的一个物件转移至你选择的目的地。如果目标为一个物件，则其必须为大型Large或更小，且不能被一名非自愿生物持握或携带。
你必须知道目的地，且目的地必须与你位于同一个存在位面。你对目的地的熟悉程度决定了你抵达目的地的成功率。DM骰1d100并参照传送结果表和其后的详述。

传送结果Teleportation Outcome 
熟悉程度 遇难 相似区域 偏离地点 抵达地点
永久法阵 - - - 01-00
相关物件 - - - 01-00
非常熟悉 01-05 06-13 14-24 25-00
偶尔见过 01-33 34-43 44-53 54-00
看过一次或听过描述 01-43 44-53 54-73 74-00
查无此地 01-50 51-00 - -

熟悉程度Familiarity。 表中熟悉程度一列的词汇解释如下：
“永久法阵” 指某处你知道其印记序列的永久传送法阵。
“相关物件”指你持有一件在过去六个月内从目标地点取来的物件，例如某个法师图书馆内的一本书。
“非常熟悉” 指你常去的地方，你仔细研究过的地方，或是你在施展该法术时能看见的地方。
“偶尔见过” 指你见过几次的地方，但你不是很熟悉。
“见过一次或听过描述”指你只见过一次的地方，包括通过魔法看到的地点，或你从别人那里听来位置和外观的地点，比如从地图上看来的地点。
“查无此地”指根本不存在的地点。也许你尝试探知敌人的密室但看到的只是幻象，或是你尝试传送至一个如今已不再存在的地点。
遇难Mishap。该法术不可控的魔法效果导致这次旅行特别艰难。尝试传送的所有生物（或目标物件）受到3d10点力场伤害，随后DM重骰d100并查阅上表来决定你们出现在哪里（你们可能再次遇难，而每次遇难都要承受该伤害）。

相似地区Similar Area。你和你的队伍（或目标物件）出现在一个和目的地外观或主题相似的不同地点。你出现在最近的相似地区。例如，如果你想回你自己的研究室去，则你可能会误打误撞出现在同一座城市其他法师的研究室里。

偏离地点Off Target。 你和你的队伍（或目标物件）出现在目的地随机方向上2d12里距离的一点。骰1d8来判误差出现在目的地的哪个方向：1，正东；2，东南；3，正南；4，西南；5，正西；6，西北；7，正北；8，东北。

抵达地点On Target。 你和你的队伍（或目标物件）出现在你欲抵达的地点。
target:
This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures you can see within range, or one object you can see within range, to a destination you choose. An object target must be Large or smaller and can't be held or carried by an unwilling creature.
You must know the destination, and it must be on the same plane of existence as you. Your familiarity with it determines your chance of arriving successfully. The DM rolls 1d100 and consults the Teleportation Outcome table and the explanations below.

Teleportation Outcome
Familiarity | Mishap | Similar Area | Off Target | On Target
Permanent circle | - | - | - | 01-00
Associated object | - | - | - | 01-00
Very familiar | 01-05 | 06-13 | 14-24 | 25-00
Seen casually | 01-33 | 34-43 | 44-53 | 54-00
Seen once or described | 01-43 | 44-53 | 54-73 | 74-00
False destination | 01-50 | 51-00 | - | -

Familiarity. The terms in the table's Familiarity column mean the following:
"Permanent circle" means a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.
"Associated object" means you possess an object taken from the destination within the past six months, such as a book from a wizard's library.
"Very familiar" means a place you visit often, have studied carefully, or can see when you cast the spell.
"Seen casually" means a place you have seen a few times but don't know well.
"Seen once or described" means a place you have seen only once, including through magic, or whose location and appearance you learned about from someone else, such as from a map.
"False destination" means a place that doesn't exist. You might have tried to scry an enemy's secret room but seen only an illusion, or tried to teleport to a place that no longer exists.
Mishap. The spell's unpredictable magic makes the journey particularly difficult. Every creature trying to teleport, or the target object, takes 3d10 Force damage. The DM then rerolls d100 and consults the table to determine where you appear. Another mishap can occur, and each one deals this damage.

Similar Area. You and your group, or the target object, appear in a different place that resembles the destination in appearance or theme. You appear in the nearest similar area. For example, if you try to return to your own laboratory, you might arrive in another wizard's laboratory in the same city.

Off Target. You and your group, or the target object, appear 2d12 li from the destination in a random direction. Roll 1d8 to determine the direction from the destination: 1, east; 2, southeast; 3, south; 4, southwest; 5, west; 6, northwest; 7, north; 8, northeast.

On Target. You and your group, or the target object, appear at your intended destination.
note: The complete six-row/four-outcome table, all familiarity definitions, repeated mishap damage, and eight-direction list are retained. The source says you plus up to eight creatures and a flat 2d12 li off-target distance; neither is replaced with another edition's rules. Bare li and 00 table endpoints remain literal.

source: 你念诵阿撒托斯的隐秘名讳，将一个生物引向注定的死亡。该生物在其每个回合结束时获得1诅咒点，当该生物获得3诅咒点时，它立即死亡。这个法术所产生的所有诅咒点将在法术结束时消失。
context: column:M;spell:Dread Curse of Azathoth;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:7
target: You speak Azathoth's secret names, steering a creature toward inevitable death. At the end of each of its turns, it gains 1 curse point. When it has 3 curse points, it dies immediately. All curse points created by this spell disappear when the spell ends.
note: Preserves end-turn accumulation, death at three points, and spell-end removal; no new save is added.

source: 选择施法范围内你能看见的一个生物，你暂时地剥夺目标生理上的一切抵抗力，足以让一个小小的划伤变成致命的伤口。直到你的下个回合结束前，目标失去所有伤害类型的抗性和免疫，同时获得所有伤害类型的易伤，在所有豁免检定上获得劣势。
target: Choose a creature you can see within range. You temporarily strip away its physical defenses, making even a small scratch potentially fatal. Until the end of your next turn, it loses Resistance and Immunity to all damage types, gains Vulnerability to all damage types, and has Disadvantage on all saving throws.
note: All three defense changes and the caster-next-turn endpoint are retained; no unprinted attack roll or save is added.

source:
你在施法距离内一处固体表面上创造一面恶心的、黄绿色的毒素烟雾墙。你可以选择创造长不过 60 尺、高不过 20 尺、厚不过 1 尺的直线型毒墙；或是直径不过 20 尺、高不过 20 尺、厚不过 1 尺的环形墙。毒气墙不透明，且将持续存在至法术终止。
墙壁出现时，所有位于毒气墙区域内的生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到10d4点强酸伤害。豁免成功则伤害减半。
当你施展此法术时，由你选择的墙壁的一面会释放出有毒的烟雾。每个在这一侧30尺范围内或在墙壁内结束回合的生物将承受8d8点毒素伤害。当一个生物在他的回合内第一次进入墙壁时，也会承受同样的伤害。墙壁的另一侧不会造成伤害。
当一个生物因墙壁受到毒素伤害时，必须通过一次体质豁免，否则将在法术持续时间内陷入中毒状态。
升环施法效应：使用八环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比七环高一环，法术就额外造成2d8点伤害。
target:
You create a nauseating wall of yellow-green poisonous fumes on a solid surface within range. It can be a straight wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ring up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts until the spell ends.
When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d4 Acid damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
When you cast the spell, choose one side of the wall to release poisonous fumes. A creature that ends its turn within 30 feet of that side or inside the wall takes 8d8 Poison damage. A creature also takes this damage when it enters the wall for the first time on its own turn. The other side deals no damage.
When a creature takes Poison damage from the wall, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for the spell's duration.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast the spell with a level-eight or higher slot, it deals an extra 2d8 damage for each slot level above level seven.
note: The initial Acid save and later Poison damage/save are separate. The source entry trigger says the creature's own turn; upcasting doesn't identify which damage component gains 2d8, so the translation doesn't assign it.

source: 你从手中显现的光之弓上射出一支天使之箭。对施法距离内的一个生物进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到4d10点力场伤害，且直到法术结束前，它将对你选择的下列伤害类型之一变得易伤：强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电、暗蚀、光耀或雷鸣。若该生物对所选伤害类型免疫，则在持续时间内改为具有该类型的抗性；若该生物对所选伤害类型具有抗性，则在持续时间内失去该抗性。
target: You fire an angelic arrow from a bow of light that manifests in your hand. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, it takes 4d10 Force damage and, until the spell ends, gains Vulnerability to one of these damage types you choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Radiant, or Thunder. If it is immune to the chosen type, it instead has Resistance to that type for the duration. If it has Resistance to that type, it loses that Resistance for the duration.
note: All seven choices and the separate Immunity-to-Resistance / Resistance-removal alternatives are retained without collapsing them into universal Vulnerability.

此法术能将一片腐肉地变成一场充满力量的盛宴。在持续时间内，你选择的任意生物都可以食用任何生物的腐肉。当法术持续时间结束时，如果一个生物在整个持续时间内都吃了腐肉，其会恢复10d6点生命值，恢复一半已消耗的生命骰（至少1）。移除其一半的力竭等级（至少1）并获得完成一次短休的所有好处。生物必须在法术结束时通过一次体质豁免，否则陷入中毒1小时。
升环施法。如果使用9环法术位施展该法术，受影响的生物会移除所有力竭等级并恢复所有消耗的生命骰。
target:
This spell turns a field of carrion into an empowering feast. For the duration, any creatures you choose can eat the carrion of any creature. At the end of the duration, a creature that ate carrion throughout the entire duration regains 10d6 Hit Points, recovers half its expended Hit Dice with a minimum of 1, removes half its levels of Exhaustion with a minimum of 1, and gains all the benefits of finishing a Short Rest. A creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw when the spell ends or have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: If cast with a level 9 spell slot, affected creatures remove all levels of Exhaustion and recover all expended Hit Dice.
note: Full-duration eating, both half/minimum recoveries, Short Rest benefits, end-spell poison save, and ninth-level exception retained. No rounding direction for halves is invented.

你能迅速降低目标的年龄。选择施法距离内一生物。在施法时，以及在你的每个回合开始时、你的目标必须进行一次体质豁免、若豁免成功，其年龄会减少1d4+1岁，如果失败则减少1岁。目标一旦降到婴儿期，就会停止衰老过程。被减龄的生物会保留其所有记忆、属性值和特性，但每减龄5年就会获得1层力竭，中型生物不能使用带有重型属性的武器。降到婴儿期的中型生物不能挥舞武器或使用工具。 如果法术在1分钟内结束，目标恢复到其真实年龄。否则，目标会永久降为新的年龄。移除诅咒Remove Curse或高等复原术Greater Restoration可将生物恢复到其真实年龄。
如果你失去了对本法术的专注，你就会获得等同于目标从该法术获得的等额力竭等级。
context: column:M;spell:Doom of Summer Years;book:黯潮之书;level:7
target:
You rapidly reduce a target's age. Choose a creature within range. When you cast the spell and at the start of each of your turns, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, its age decreases by 1d4 + 1 years; on a failed save, it decreases by 1 year. The age change stops once it reaches infancy. A creature made younger retains all its memories, ability scores, and traits, but gains 1 level of Exhaustion for every 5 years removed. A Medium creature can't use weapons with the Heavy property. A Medium creature reduced to infancy can't wield weapons or use tools. If the spell ends within 1 minute, the target returns to its true age; otherwise, it permanently remains at its new age. Remove Curse or Greater Restoration can restore its true age.
If you lose Concentration on this spell, you gain as many levels of Exhaustion as the target gained from it.
note: The source assigns larger age reduction to success (1d4+1 years) and one year to failure; this is preserved, not reversed. Its infancy stopping sentence, Medium-only weapon restrictions, minute boundary, and caster Exhaustion consequence are all retained.

source:
你选择施法距离内地面上可见一点的，法术持续期间，黑风和暗影物质流以该点为中心，在半径100尺的范围内呼啸着改变地形，有时还会淹没该区域内的生物。
该区域变为困难地形。每个触碰该区域的生物都必须进行一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，则该生物提升一级力竭。当你施展此法术时，以及在专注此法术的每个回合结束时，该区域地面上的每个生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免。 豁免失败的生物会应击倒地。
黑檀之潮会在法术结束前在你的每个回合开始时对该区域内任何与地面接触的建筑物造成30钝击伤害。如果建筑物的生命值为0，则会沉入地底，被影域吞噬。建筑物内的任何生物必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败的生物会受到2d12暗蚀伤害，倒地并陷入目盲一轮。豁免成功者所受伤害减半且不会目盲和倒地。
此法术会根据该区域的地形而产生额外效果，由DM决定。下列效果中，一次施展的“黑檀之潮”的效果不能超过两种。
丘陵和裂谷Hills and Hollows。 在你施法后的你的下一个回合开始时，地面上升或下沉。 这些变化以山丘、断层（新的悬崖）或空洞。一共有 1d4个这样的山丘、断层或凹洞在地点生成。 空洞或断层会导致建筑物自动坍塌（见上文）。空洞或山丘可以改变当地水流，如护城河、溪流或湖泊。
河流、海岸和水域Rivers, Shores, and Waters。 该地区的水流可以沿用原来的河道（如扭弯），或被卷入新的河道。 施法后只能改变一种水的要素。（例如，你不能同时改变一片湖泊和一条溪流）。
暗影泥沼Shadow Mire。 受术范围内的所有地面在法术持续时间内变成暗影泥沼shadow mire（见第五章）。
target:
Choose a point you can see on the ground within range. For the duration, black winds and streams of shadow matter roar within a radius of 100 feet around it, reshaping the terrain and sometimes engulfing creatures in the area.
The area becomes Difficult Terrain. Each creature touching the area must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining one level of Exhaustion on a failed save. When you cast the spell and at the end of each turn during which you maintain Concentration on it, each creature on the ground in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, falling Prone on a failed save.
Until the spell ends, at the start of each of your turns, Ebon Tide deals 30 Bludgeoning damage to any structure in the area that is in contact with the ground. A structure at 0 Hit Points sinks into the earth and is swallowed by the Shadow Realm. Any creature inside must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d12 Necrotic damage, falls Prone, and is Blinded for one round. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is neither Blinded nor knocked Prone.
The spell also produces terrain-dependent effects determined by the DM. A single casting of Ebon Tide can produce no more than two of the following effects.
Hills and Hollows. At the start of your next turn after casting, the ground rises or sinks, forming hills, faults that create new cliffs, or hollows. A total of 1d4 such hills, faults, or hollows form in the area. Hollows or faults cause structures to collapse automatically, as described above. Hollows or hills can alter local waters, such as moats, streams, or lakes.
Rivers, Shores, and Waters. Water in the area can follow its existing channel, such as bending it, or be drawn into a new channel. Only one water feature can be changed after casting; for example, you can't change both a lake and a stream.
Shadow Mire. All ground in the spell's area becomes shadow mire for the duration; see chapter five.
note: All three terrain options, maximum two per casting, separate creature saves and structure timing, collapse consequences, and chapter reference retained. The source's Dexterity-save timing says each turn of concentration, whereas structure damage explicitly says each of your turns; this wording is not silently unified.

source: 以你为中心半径20尺内在你施法时所有生命值低于你的生物都会被魅惑跳起曳步舞。任何无法被魅惑的生物都对该法术的效果免疫。受影响的生物移动速度减半，不能使用反应，且在其回合内只能进行一次武器或法术攻击。在其回合开始时，一个在该区域内的生物可以选择受到1d4级力竭来结束此法术对自身的影响。从该法术中获得力竭等级的生物可以在完成一次短休后清除所有这些力竭。
target: When you cast the spell, every creature within a 20-foot radius of you that has fewer Hit Points than you is Charmed into dancing a shuffle. Creatures that can't be Charmed are immune to the spell. Affected creatures have their movement speeds halved, can't take Reactions, and can make only one weapon or spell attack on their turns. At the start of its turn, a creature in the area can choose to gain 1d4 levels of Exhaustion to end the spell's effect on itself. A creature that gains Exhaustion from this spell can remove all of those levels by finishing a Short Rest.
note: Preserves the casting-time HP comparison, charm immunity, attack/reaction limits, optional Exhaustion exit, and Short Rest removal only of this spell's Exhaustion.

source: 你将魔法性的治愈能量注入你触碰的一名生物，持续至法术结束。每当该生物使用法术位施展一道法术时，它都可以立即掷等于该法术位的环阶枚生命骰，并恢复等于掷骰结果+你的施法属性调整值点生命值；这些生命骰将因此消耗。
context: column:M;spell:Simbul's Synostodweomer;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:7
target: You infuse a creature you touch with magical healing energy until the spell ends. Whenever it casts a spell using a spell slot, it can immediately roll a number of Hit Dice equal to the slot's level and regain Hit Points equal to the total rolled + your spellcasting ability modifier. Those Hit Dice are expended.
note: The healing roll is optional and consumes the dice; the modifier is the caster's and is added to the rolled result, not explicitly to each die.

source:
选择施法距离内任意数量的自愿生物。每个目标都变形为一只挑战等级不超过4，体型不超过大型的野兽。你可以将每个目标变为不同的形态。在法术持续时间内之后的回合中，你可以使用一个魔法 动作将这些目标再度变形。
生物的游戏数据被选择的野兽资料卡替换，但目标保留其生物类型、生命值、生命骰、阵营、交流的能力以及智力、感知、魅力属性值。目标的动作受到新形态身体结构的限制，并且无法施法。目标的装备会融入其新形态，而且处于此形态时无法使用这些被融入的装备。
目标获得等于野兽形态生命值的临时生命值。该变形会在持续时间结束或目标失去所有临时生命值时结束，目标也能以一个附赠动作变回原型以结束此法术。
target:
Choose any number of willing creatures within range. Each transforms into a Large or smaller Beast with a Challenge Rating no higher than 4. You can choose a different form for each target. On subsequent turns for the duration, you can take a Magic action to transform the targets again.
A target's game statistics are replaced by the chosen Beast's stat block, but it retains its creature type, Hit Points, Hit Dice, alignment, ability to communicate, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. Its actions are limited by its new anatomy, and it can't cast spells. Its equipment merges into the new form and can't be used while merged.
The target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Beast form's Hit Points. The transformation ends when the duration ends or the target loses all its Temporary Hit Points. The target can also take a Bonus Action to return to its original form and end the spell.
note: All retained statistic categories, CR/size limits, retransform action, communication exception, merged gear, and three ending methods remain. The source's final end-the-spell wording is retained without inventing a global/per-target ruling.

source:
一道反魔法灵光环绕着你形成10尺光环区域。在灵光内部无法施展法术，使用魔法动作或创造魔法效应，并且这些事物也无法以灵光内的任何事物为目标或影响灵光内部的任何事物。魔法物品的魔法属性在灵光内部不起作用，也无法影响处于灵光内部的任何事物。
法术和其他魔法效应产生的效应区域无法延伸至灵光内部。传送无法进出其范围，位面旅行在该范围内无法使用。当传送门处于灵光内部时，传送门会暂时关闭。
正在持续中的法术在区域内会被压制，除非该法术为某个神器或某位神明所施展。压制的魔法效应不会生效，但该魔法效应受压制的时间仍然如常计入其总持续时间。
解除魔法Dispel Magic 对灵光无效，而由不同反魔法场法术所创造的灵光之间也不会相互抵消。
target:
An antimagic aura surrounds you in a 10-foot Emanation. Spells can't be cast, Magic actions can't be used, and magical effects can't be created inside it. These things also can't target or affect anything inside the aura. Magic items' magical properties don't function inside it and can't affect anything there.
The areas of spells and other magical effects can't extend into the aura. Teleportation can't enter or leave it, and planar travel can't be used within it. A portal is temporarily closed while inside the aura.
Ongoing spells are suppressed in the area unless cast by an Artifact or a deity. Suppressed magical effects don't function, but time spent suppressed still counts toward their durations.
Dispel Magic has no effect on the aura, and auras created by different Antimagic Field spells don't cancel each other out.
note: The Artifact/deity exception remains attached to ongoing-spell suppression as written. Magic actions, item effects, areas, teleportation, planar travel, portals, durations, and aura interactions are complete.

当你施展此法术时，选择它是产生嫌恶还是关怀效应，并选择一个巨型或更小体型的生物或物件。然后指定特定类型的生物，比如红龙、地精或吸血鬼。当此类生物进入被选择的生物120尺内时，它必须进行一次感知豁免。你选择的嫌恶或关怀效应会决定当豁免失败时，这个生物身上产生的效应。
　　• 嫌恶术Antipathy。该生物将陷入恐慌 状态。因此陷入恐慌的生物必须在其回合内使用其移动力尽可能远离目标，并沿着最安全的路线移动。
　　• 关怀术Sympathy。该生物将陷入魅惑状态。因此陷入魅惑的生物必须在其回合内使用其移动力尽可能接近目标，并沿着最安全的路线移动。如果该生物位于目标的5尺内，它不能自主远离目标。如果目标伤害陷入魅惑 的生物，该生物能够如下文描述一样进行一次感知豁免来结束这一效应。
结束效应Ending the Effect。如果陷入恐慌或魅惑 的生物在距离目标距离120尺以上结束时结束回合，该生物进行一次感知豁免。豁免成功的情况下，该生物不再被目标影响。在对抗该效应的豁免中成功的生物将不受此法术的效应影响，持续 1 分钟，随后仍可能受到该效应影响。
target:
When you cast this spell, choose whether it produces Antipathy or Sympathy, and choose a Huge or smaller creature or object. Then specify a particular kind of creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. When a creature of that kind comes within 120 feet of the chosen creature, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. Your choice of Antipathy or Sympathy determines the effect on a failed save.
• Antipathy. The creature has the Frightened condition. While Frightened this way, it must use its movement on its turn to travel as far from the target as possible by the safest route.
• Sympathy. The creature has the Charmed condition. While Charmed this way, it must use its movement on its turn to approach the target as closely as possible by the safest route. If within 5 feet of the target, it can't willingly move away. If the target harms the Charmed creature, it can make a Wisdom saving throw to end the effect, as described below.
Ending the Effect. If a Frightened or Charmed creature ends its turn 120 feet or more from the target, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the target no longer affects it. A creature that succeeds on a save against the effect is unaffected by the spell for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.
note: The source permits a creature or object target but describes the initial 120-foot trigger as distance from the chosen creature; that wording inconsistency is preserved. The ending distance says 120 feet or more. Both safe-route movements, harm save, and one-minute immunity are retained.

source:
你将一个施法距离内你可见的生物的心灵爆破。该目标必须进行一次智力豁免。
若豁免失败，目标受到10d12心灵伤害，并且无法施展法术也无法执行魔法动作。受术生物每过 30 日即可在当日结束时重复进行该豁免，豁免成功则此法术效应终止。此效应也可以被高等复原术Greater Restoration、医疗术Heal、祈愿术Wish 法术终止。
若豁免成功，则目标只会受到一半伤害。
target:
You blast the mind of a creature you can see within range. It must make an Intelligence saving throw.
On a failed save, it takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take Magic actions. Every 30 days, it can repeat the save at the end of that day, ending the effect on a success. Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish can also end the effect.
On a successful save, the target takes only half as much damage.
note: No ability-score reduction from another spell version is added. The 30-day retry and all three restoration spells are preserved.

法术成分： V、S、M（一枚价值1000GP+的钻石作为法术耗材。以及一副价值2000GP+的带密封功能的大容器，其尺寸必须足以存放一个要被克隆的生物）
持续时间：立即
你触碰一名被生物或其不小于1立方寸的血肉。在施展法术使用的容器中，一具该生物的无生命克隆体成形，你可以选择克隆体是和该生物同龄或是更年轻的版本。在容器未被外界影响时，其中的躯体会一直保持无意识的静止状态。这个克隆体在120日后成熟。
如果本体生物在克隆体成熟后死亡，则其灵魂转移到克隆体中，前提是该灵魂必须保持自由且愿意归来。克隆体的肉体特质与本体相同，并具有相同的个性、记忆和能力，但不具有本体的随身装备。由于灵魂已经转移到别处，该生物原本的遗体（如果依然存在）失去活力，且不能被复活。
target:
Components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 1000 GP, which the spell consumes, and a sealable vessel worth at least 2000 GP, large enough to hold the creature being cloned)
Duration: Instantaneous
You touch a creature or at least 1 cubic cun of its flesh. An inert clone of the creature forms in the vessel used to cast the spell. You can choose a clone of its current age or a younger version. The body remains unconscious and still while the vessel is undisturbed. The clone matures after 120 days.
If the original creature dies after the clone matures, its soul transfers into the clone, provided the soul is free and willing to return. The clone has the original's physical characteristics, personality, memories, and abilities, but none of its equipment. Because the soul has moved elsewhere, the original remains, if any, are inert and can't be restored to life.
note: The full embedded component/duration text, consumed diamond versus retained vessel, and both minimum prices are retained. The broken creature wording is rendered as a creature without inventing eligibility. Bare cubic cun is not converted to cubic inches; free/willing soul and mature-clone conditions remain.

target:
You control the weather within 5 li of you for the duration. You must be outdoors when you cast the spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.
When you cast the spell, you can change the current weather, determined by the DM. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. New conditions take 1d4 × 10 minutes to take effect. Once they do, you can change the weather again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.
